summary: Model routers and AI gateways can select a low-cost model first, estimate quality or confidence, and apply bounded fallbacks. Quality-based escalation must be distinguished from availability retries, which only prove that another endpoint answered.

items.text: Amazon Bedrock intelligent prompt routing predicts response-quality differences among configured models, balances quality against cost, and uses a specified fallback model when routing criteria are not met.

RouteLLM provides learned routers trained from preference data, an OpenAI-compatible serving layer, and evaluation scripts for measuring quality and cost when selecting between stronger and weaker models.

Cloudflare AI Gateway Dynamic Routing defines versioned JSON or visual flows with conditional model selection, quotas, spend limits, and fallbacks, enabling an explicit bounded cascade at the gateway.

LiteLLM Proxy reliability controls configure retries and ordered model fallbacks across providers; these handle errors, rate limits, and outages, but require a separate evaluator for quality-triggered escalation.
